### What landed this round (M3 + M10 + M13)

[Section titled “What landed this round (M3 + M10 + M13)”](#what-landed-this-round-m3--m10--m13)

**M3 — Tarball signing (Ed25519)**

* Server: keypair auto-generated at startup at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-keys/marketplace-ed25519.{pem,pub}`. New endpoint `GET /v1/keys/marketplace.pub`. Every published tarball gets a `signature.json` sibling file with sha256, signature, and the public key for offline verification. Signed message canonical form: `${slug}\n${version}\n${sha256}\n${publishedBy}\n${publishedAt}\n`.
* Client: `papercusp install` fetches the public key (24h cache at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-keys-cache.json`), recomputes sha256 of the downloaded tarball, and calls `crypto.verify` against the signature. Tampering hard-fails with cleanup of the partial install. Legacy packages without `signature.json` warn but proceed (backward compat). `--no-verify` flag bypasses for offline / debug paths.
* Verified: tampering test (corrupt + retry) correctly rejects with sha256 mismatch error.

**M10 — Size & bandwidth quotas**

* Tarball cap 50 MB (HTTP 413 with clear message), manifest cap 64 KB, README cap 256 KB — all checked at upload before disk write.
* Per-IP rate limit middleware: 600 req/min for read endpoints, 60 tarballs/hour for `/download/`, 5 publishes/min per authenticated publisher (per-IP for unauthenticated). Returns HTTP 429 with `Retry-After` header.
* Per-publisher daily quota tracking at `~/.papercusp/marketplace-storage/.publisher-quotas.json`: 50 publishes/day, 1 GB aggregate storage. Resets at UTC rollover. Only enforces when authenticated.
* Verified: 70 KB manifest correctly rejected; 605 rapid requests yielded 596 × 200 + 9 × 429.

**M13 — Multi-registry resolution**

* CLI reads `~/.papercusp/config.json` for `registries[]` array.
* `resolveRegistry(slug)` walks scopes in order; first match wins. `*` matches anything; `@owner/*` matches `@owner/anything`.
* `--registry <url>` flag overrides config for one-off installs.
* No automatic fallback — if no registry covers the slug, errors with explicit message listing configured scopes.
* Slug regex extended to accept scoped names (`@owner/package`); version splitter handles `@avi/foo@1.2.0` correctly.
* Verified: 4 scenarios — scoped → internal, no-match → error, `--registry` override → bypasses config, no config → falls back to `PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_URL`.

Files touched this round:

* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — keypair gen, signing, public key endpoint, rate limit middleware, manifest/README size caps, publisher quota tracking
* `libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts` — signature verification on install, `--no-verify` and `--registry` flags, scoped-slug support, registry resolver

Production state after this round:

* `https://api.papercuspai.com/v1/keys/marketplace.pub` — returns Ed25519 public key
* `https://api.papercuspai.com/catalog/signed-test/0.1.0` — includes `signature` field in the response
* Existing legacy packages (papercup-coding, papercup-org) continue to work without signatures

**Original estimate**: 42-52 hours total. **After three rounds shipped (M2.5 + M3 + M4 + M5 + M6 + M7 + M9 + M10 + M13)**: \~17-22 hours remaining. **Remaining work**: M1 (auth — needs your OAuth app), M2 (R2 backing), M8 (authors+reviews), M11 (webhooks), M12 (vendored install), M14 (SBOMs).

### What landed in round 3 (M6 + M9 + M4)

[Section titled “What landed in round 3 (M6 + M9 + M4)”](#what-landed-in-round-3-m6--m9--m4)

**M6 — Package retraction**

* New SQL migration `002-retraction-and-stats.sql` adding `package_retraction_log` audit table.
* 7 new POST endpoints: `/v1/packages/:slug/{deprecate,undeprecate,withdraw,unwithdraw,quarantine,unquarantine}` and `/v1/packages/:slug/versions/:version/yank`.
* 4-tier model per spec §11.9: Deprecated → Yanked → Withdrawn → Quarantined.
* Quarantine + unquarantine require operator token (`PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_TOKEN` env var).
* All retraction actions log to `package_retraction_log` (slug, action, reason, actor, is\_operator, timestamp).
* `GET /download/:slug/:version` now returns HTTP 410 for `withdrawn` or `quarantined` packages.
* New `GET /v1/installed-status?slugs=A,B,C` endpoint for substrate-side polling per spec §11.9.

**M9 — Download stats**

* `package_downloads` table (slug, version, day, downloads counter), date-partitioned for archival.
* View `v_popularity` for rolling 30-day per-package totals.
* Async `bumpDownload()` on every successful `GET /download/`.
* New `GET /v1/stats/:slug` returns total, 30-day, by-version, by-day breakdown.

**M4 — Server-side search**

* New `GET /v1/search?q=&limit=` endpoint using Postgres LIKE (catalog still small; will swap to Typesense at >1k packages).
* Searches across slug, description, owner.
* Excludes withdrawn/quarantined packages by default (only returns `retracted = 'active'`).
* Empty query returns most-recently-updated packages.

Files touched in round 3:

* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/002-retraction-and-stats.sql` — new migration
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/db.ts` — applyRetraction, bumpDownload, getDownloadStats, getPackageState, listInstalledStatus, getMarketplaceSql exported
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — 9 new endpoints, retraction guard on /download/, async stats counter

Verified end-to-end:

* Deprecate/yank/withdraw all log to audit table ✓
* Quarantine requires operator token (401 without; 200 with) ✓
* Withdrawn package returns 410 on /download/ ✓
* Substrate poll endpoint returns retraction state for installed slugs ✓
* 4 downloads of signed-test correctly counted in stats ✓
* Search for “sign” finds signed-test; “paper” finds papercup-org ✓
* Production API responds 200 on all new endpoints ✓

### What landed in round 2 (M2.5 + M5 + M7)

[Section titled “What landed in round 2 (M2.5 + M5 + M7)”](#what-landed-in-round-2-m25--m5--m7)

**M2.5 — Postgres metadata schema (dual-write)**

* New schema `papercusp_marketplace` in `papercusp` DB (migration at `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/001-marketplace-schema.sql`).
* Tables: `packages` (slug + owner + retracted state), `package_versions` (manifest + signature + tier breakdown + tarball metadata).
* Trigger maintains `updated_at` on package mutations.
* marketplace-api dual-writes on every successful publish (FS still source of truth during this rollout).
* Backfill script (`npm run backfill`) populates DB from existing FS state; idempotent for re-runs.
* All 3 existing packages (papercup-coding, papercup-org, signed-test) backfilled successfully.

**M5 — Update / uninstall / rollback CLI**

* New state file at `~/.papercusp/installed-plugins.json` tracking each install: slug, version, install path, applied migration index, granted capabilities, manifest snapshot.

* `papercusp install` now records into this state on success.

* `papercusp update <slug> [--yes]`:

  * Fetches latest from registry; no-op if up to date.
  * Diffs capabilities (added / removed) and reports.
  * Snapshots old version to `~/.papercusp/snapshots/<slug>/<old-version>/` (full files dir + manifest + granted-caps.json).
  * Re-installs the new version atomically.
  * Records new state.

* `papercusp uninstall <slug> [--purge-data]`:

  * Default: removes plugin code + state, **preserves Postgres data**.
  * `--purge-data`: also flags schema for cleanup (manual review since manifest doesn’t yet declare a schema name).

* `papercusp rollback <slug>`:

  * Re-mounts most recent snapshot.
  * Updates state to reflect rolled-back version.
  * Surfaces “DB rollback is your responsibility” warning per spec §11.7.

**M7 — Detail page rich UX**

* Site: `/marketplace/[slug]/` now surfaces:

  * **Verified (signed) / Unverified badge** — green if signature present, amber otherwise.
  * **Install shape badge** (Iterative / Scheduled / Reactive / Passive) when `manifest.shape` set, with tooltip explaining the shape.
  * **Capability tier breakdown** — colored counts (high / medium / low), expandable to see all caps.
  * **Service ABI pins** sidebar when `manifest.services` set.
  * **publishedBy** linked to GitHub profile when stamped.
  * **publishedAt** human-readable.
  * **Signature provenance** sidebar with algo + sha256 + signed-by.

* Helper `tierCapabilities()` and `SHAPE_LABEL` constants in `lib/format.ts` shared with the catalog grid for future filters.

* Built + deployed to Cloudflare Pages (deployment `0aba4673`) — verified the new strings are in the JS chunks served from `papercuspai.com`.

Files touched in round 2:

* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/sql/001-marketplace-schema.sql` — new migration
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/db.ts` — new postgres-js client + upsertPackageVersion + categorizeCapabilities
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/server.ts` — dual-write call in publish handler
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/src/backfill.ts` — new one-time backfill script
* `libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-api/package.json` — added `postgres` dep + `backfill` script

### Suggested phase ordering

[Section titled “Suggested phase ordering”](#suggested-phase-ordering)

Not all phases are equal priority. Here’s the order I’d run them in, by what unblocks the most usage:

1. **M1 (auth)** — block until landed; everything downstream assumes verified identities.
2. **M2 + M2.5 (R2 + Postgres metadata)** — durability + scale; necessary before significant publishing.
3. **M3 (tarball signing)** — supply chain integrity; prerequisite for verified-tier display.
4. **M7 (detail page UX)** — surface what M1+M3 enable to users.
5. **M5 (update/uninstall)** — close the install loop; users need this before they install anything important.
6. **M10 (quotas)** — anti-abuse before the marketplace is opened publicly.
7. **M6 (retraction)** — operational maturity; needed before a real security incident.
8. **M11 (webhooks)** — unlocks ecosystem integrations.
9. **M4 (search)** — only needed once catalog > \~100 packages.
10. **M9 (stats)** — nice-to-have signal; not blocking.
11. **M8 (reviews)** — community feature; needs moderation tooling.
12. **M12 (vendored)** — enterprise / air-gapped customers.
13. **M13 (multi-registry)** — corporate mirrors with public fallback.
14. **M14 (SBOMs)** — supply chain compliance; v2.0-shaped feature.

## Operational notes

[Section titled “Operational notes”](#operational-notes)

### First-party seed templates (re-publishing)

[Section titled “First-party seed templates (re-publishing)”](#first-party-seed-templates-re-publishing)

The bundled templates `papercup-coding` and `papercup-org` are **first-party** — they’re owned by `@papercupai`, not by whoever happens to run the seed script.

Their canonical source-of-truth lives in the marketplace repo at `../papercusp-registry/seeds/papercupai/<slug>/`. They’re published via the **same publish pipeline as any user package** — no SQL backfill, no special case in the server.

Two auth modes cover this:

**Service token (recommended for CI / seed scripts):** A static bearer token bound to a publisher login. The marketplace operator issues it via `PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_SERVICE_TOKENS` env (JSON array of `{token, login}` entries). Then:

```bash
PAPERCUSP_SERVICE_TOKEN=<your-token> \
PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_URL=http://localhost:3057 \
  papercusp publish     # from inside seeds/papercupai/<slug>/
```

The CLI sends the token as `Authorization: Bearer ...`; the server matches it against the configured table and stamps `publishedBy` from the bound login. No OAuth round-trip, no browser, fully scriptable.

**OAuth Device Flow (for human publishing as @papercupai):** `papercusp login` then `papercusp publish`. Requires the @papercupai GitHub account/org to exist and you to be able to authenticate as it.

**Don’t** insert seed packages directly via SQL or backfill scripts — that bypasses the publish pipeline (signing, indexing, webhook events) and creates orphan-attribution problems. The seeds README at `../papercusp-registry/seeds/README.md` documents the policy.

### Local development

[Section titled “Local development”](#local-development)

The marketplace-api runs as a systemd —user transient unit named `marketplace-api`, defined at `~/.config/systemd/user/marketplace-api.service`. It’s started automatically alongside `bin/dev` and survives shell exits.

```bash
# Status / restart / logs
systemctl --user status marketplace-api
systemctl --user restart marketplace-api
journalctl --user -u marketplace-api -f
# or: tail -f ~/.papercusp/logs/marketplace-api.log


# Manual run (if you need to iterate without the unit):
cd ../papercusp-registry && npm run dev:api      # listens on :3057


# Build + serve site locally
cd ../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-site
BUILD_API_BASE=http://localhost:3057 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.papercuspai.com npm run build
npx serve out -l 3060        # http://localhost:3060
```

### Production deploy

[Section titled “Production deploy”](#production-deploy)

```bash
cd libs/papercusp/apps/marketplace-site
BUILD_API_BASE=http://localhost:3057 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE=https://api.papercuspai.com npm run build
npx wrangler pages deploy ./out --project-name papercuspai --branch main --commit-dirty=true
```

The marketplace-api process must be running on `localhost:3057` for the build’s `generateStaticParams` step (which fetches the catalog to pre-render `/marketplace/[slug]/` pages). After M2 lands, this becomes optional — Postgres metadata can serve build-time too.

### Cloudflare touchpoints

[Section titled “Cloudflare touchpoints”](#cloudflare-touchpoints)

* **Pages project:** `papercuspai` (domain attached, deploys via wrangler)
* **Tunnel:** `papercupai-api` (UUID `c53515b3-edfe-4e99-813b-e3916ae9d02c`) — same tunnel as papercupai.com, with two ingress rules (one per hostname)
* **DNS apex:** `papercuspai.com` → `papercuspai.pages.dev` (CNAME, proxied)
* **DNS api:** `api.papercuspai.com` → tunnel UUID via Zero Trust dashboard

### Known operational gotchas

[Section titled “Known operational gotchas”](#known-operational-gotchas)

* New publishes appear instantly in `/marketplace/` grid (live API fetch) but **404 on `[slug]` detail until site is rebuilt + redeployed** (`dynamicParams = false` on the static export). Future option: add an SSR fallback at the edge for unknown slugs.
* The CF token at `~/.cloudflare-token` has Pages and a few zone scopes but **NOT** `Account · Cloudflare Tunnel · Edit`. Tunnel changes require dashboard clicks today.
* `cloudflared` runs in token mode → ingress rules managed via Zero Trust dashboard, not `~/.cloudflared/config.yml`.
* Marketplace dirs were moved on 2026-04-27 from `libs/papercusp/apps/{marketplace-api,marketplace-site}` → `../papercusp-registry/apps/{marketplace-api,marketplace-site}`. If you see stale paths anywhere, that’s why.
* The `papercusp` CLI (`libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts`) lives in the **substrate** repo, not the marketplace repo. It talks to the marketplace via HTTP, so the split makes sense — but if you change the api shape on the server side, update the CLI in lockstep across both repos.

## Handoff — detailed implementation specs for remaining phases

[Section titled “Handoff — detailed implementation specs for remaining phases”](#handoff--detailed-implementation-specs-for-remaining-phases)

This section is the precise roadmap for the **3 remaining phases** if a future agent picks up. Each phase has been spec’d in §11 and partially designed earlier; here’s what an implementer needs to actually ship them.

### M2 — R2 storage backing (3-4h, **blocked on CF token scope**)

[Section titled “M2 — R2 storage backing (3-4h, blocked on CF token scope)”](#m2--r2-storage-backing-3-4h-blocked-on-cf-token-scope)

**Why it’s blocked:** Need a CF API token with `Account · R2 · Edit` to create the bucket and obtain S3-compatible credentials. The current `~/.cloudflare-token` has Pages + selected zone scopes only.

**Plan once unblocked:**

1. Create R2 bucket `papercusp-marketplace-tarballs` (CF dashboard or API):

   ```plaintext
   curl -X POST "https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94/r2/buckets" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer $CF_R2_TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"name":"papercusp-marketplace-tarballs"}'
   ```

2. Get S3-compatible access keys (CF dashboard → R2 → Manage R2 API Tokens). Add to `~/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env`:

   ```plaintext
   R2_ACCOUNT_ID=f896982ea2f6d507e4f29eeecbd26e94
   R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID=...
   R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=...
   R2_BUCKET=papercusp-marketplace-tarballs
   ```

3. Add `@aws-sdk/client-s3` to `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/package.json`:

   ```json
   "dependencies": {
     "@aws-sdk/client-s3": "^3.700.0",
     "@aws-sdk/s3-request-presigner": "^3.700.0"
   }
   ```

4. Create `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/r2.ts`:

   * `S3Client` configured with `endpoint: https://${R2_ACCOUNT_ID}.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, `region: 'auto'`
   * `uploadTarball(slug, version, buf)` → `s3.send(new PutObjectCommand(...))`
   * `getDownloadUrl(slug, version)` → `getSignedUrl(s3, new GetObjectCommand(...), { expiresIn: 300 })`
   * Key format: `tarballs/${slug}/${version}/${slug}-${version}.tar.gz`

5. Modify `server.ts` publish handler:

   * After existing FS write to `tarballPath`, also call `uploadTarball(slug, version, buf)`
   * Continue dual-writing FS for now (rollback safety)

6. Modify `server.ts` `/download/:slug/:version`:

   * First try the R2 signed URL: redirect 302 to it
   * On any error (R2 down or migration not complete), fall back to existing FS stream
   * `papercusp_marketplace.package_versions.tarball_r2_key` column tracks if uploaded — add a migration

7. Migration script: `../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/migrate-to-r2.ts` — iterates existing FS packages, uploads each to R2, marks `tarball_r2_key` in the DB.

8. Delete FS storage AFTER verifying R2 + signed URLs serve correctly for a week.

**Schema delta (002b):**

```sql
ALTER TABLE papercusp_marketplace.package_versions
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS tarball_r2_key TEXT;
```

**Testing:**

* Unit: upload + signed URL roundtrip
* Integration: publish via CLI, verify install pulls from R2 (302 redirect chain visible)
* Failure mode: simulate R2 outage with bad credentials, verify FS fallback engages

### M8 — Author profiles + reviews (4-5h)

[Section titled “M8 — Author profiles + reviews (4-5h)”](#m8--author-profiles--reviews-4-5h)

**Schema** (003b-reviews.sql in `../papercusp-registry/sql/`):

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS papercusp_marketplace.reviews (
  id            TEXT PRIMARY KEY,                  -- 'rv_' + 24 hex
  slug          TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES papercusp_marketplace.packages(slug) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  reviewer      TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- verified GitHub login
  rating        SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(body) BETWEEN 10 AND 5000),
  created_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at    TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  hidden_at     TIMESTAMPTZ,                       -- non-null = operator hid
  hidden_reason TEXT,
  UNIQUE (slug, reviewer)                          -- one review per user per package
);


CREATE INDEX reviews_slug_idx ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews(slug);
CREATE INDEX reviews_reviewer_idx ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews(reviewer);


GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON papercusp_marketplace.reviews TO harness_app, harness_admin;
```

**Endpoints in `server.ts`:**

* `GET /v1/packages/:slug/reviews` — list reviews (excludes hidden\_at IS NOT NULL); 50 most recent
* `POST /v1/packages/:slug/reviews` — auth-required, insert/update by `(slug, reviewer)`. Reject if reviewer is the package’s `publishedBy` (no self-reviews). Reject if account < 7 days old (anti-spam).
* `DELETE /v1/packages/:slug/reviews/:id` — owner of the review only
* `POST /v1/admin/reviews/:id/hide` — operator-only; sets `hidden_at` + `hidden_reason`
* `GET /v1/authors/:login` — public profile + their packages + their reviews (last 10)

**Site changes** (`../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-site/`):

* New page `/authors/[login]/page.tsx` with `generateStaticParams` from `package_versions.published_by DISTINCT`
* New section on `/marketplace/[slug]/` (PackageClient.tsx) with reviews list + write-review form (auth-gated)
* Average rating badge on the catalog grid

**Anti-abuse rules** (per spec §8 of M8 plan):

* Reviewers from accounts < 7 days old: visible but flagged “new account”
* Reviews can be reported via `POST /v1/packages/:slug/reviews/:id/report`
* Operator UI later (deferred) for moderation queue

### M14 — SBOM attestation + CVE scanning (6-8h)

[Section titled “M14 — SBOM attestation + CVE scanning (6-8h)”](#m14--sbom-attestation--cve-scanning-6-8h)

**Schema** (005-attestations.sql):

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations (
  slug              TEXT NOT NULL,
  version           TEXT NOT NULL,
  format            TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (format IN ('spdx', 'cyclonedx')),
  sbom_json         JSONB NOT NULL,
  scanned_at        TIMESTAMPTZ,
  vulnerabilities   JSONB,                         -- [{ purl, advisory_id, severity, fixedIn }]
  PRIMARY KEY (slug, version),
  FOREIGN KEY (slug, version) REFERENCES papercusp_marketplace.package_versions(slug, version) ON DELETE CASCADE
);


CREATE INDEX attestations_unscanned_idx
  ON papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations(scanned_at) WHERE scanned_at IS NULL;
GRANT SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON papercusp_marketplace.package_attestations TO harness_app, harness_admin;
```

**Publish handler change:**

* `POST /publish/:slug/:version` accepts an additional multipart field `sbom` (JSON file). Validate against the format’s JSON schema before storing. If valid, insert into `package_attestations` with `scanned_at = NULL`.

**Scan worker** (`../papercusp-registry/apps/marketplace-api/src/sbom-scanner.ts`):

* Long-lived loop (1-min tick) drains rows where `scanned_at IS NULL`
* For each: extract package list (SPDX `packages[]` or CycloneDX `components[]`)
* For each package: query `https://api.osv.dev/v1/query` with PURL or CPE
* Store findings in `vulnerabilities[]`
* Re-scan all attestations weekly (set `scanned_at = NULL` for rows older than 7d)
* Rate limit: max 10 osv.dev queries/sec; back off on 429

**Endpoints:**

* `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom` — raw SBOM JSON
* `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/sbom/viewer` — formatted HTML (server-side render via marked.js or similar)
* `GET /v1/packages/:slug/:version/vulnerabilities` — current findings

**Site changes:**

* “Has SBOM” badge on detail page (already wired UI: just add a check)
* Vulnerability count badge if `vulnerabilities.length > 0`
* Optional: SBOM diff between two versions (deferred to v2)

**CLI:**

* `papercusp publish --sbom ./sbom.spdx.json` — multipart upload
* `papercusp install` warns if installed plugin has unpatched CVEs (queries `/v1/packages/:slug/:version/vulnerabilities` after install)

## Quick-start for a future agent

[Section titled “Quick-start for a future agent”](#quick-start-for-a-future-agent)

If you’re picking this up cold, here’s the 5-minute orientation:

1. **Where the code lives**:

   * Substrate: `papercupai/papercusp` repo → submodule at `Restart/libs/papercusp/`
   * Marketplace: `papercupai/papercusp-registry` repo → submodule at `Restart/../papercusp-registry/`
   * Spec docs: embedded in `Restart/apps/papercusp/content/docs/` and served at `localhost:3055/docs` (Fumadocs). Legacy Starlight source still in `Restart/apps/papercusp-spec/`.
   * Substrate UI: `libs/papercusp/apps/web/` (lives at `localhost:3055`)
   * CLI: `libs/papercusp/packages/cli/src/papercusp.ts`

2. **How to start everything**:

   ```bash
   cd /home/marsh-office/Restart
   # marketplace-api (port 3057):
   bash -c 'set -a; source $HOME/.papercusp/marketplace-secrets.env; set +a; nohup npm run dev:marketplace > /tmp/marketplace-api.log 2>&1 &'
   # spec docs are now served by apps/papercusp at /docs (no separate process):
   #   already running at http://localhost:3055/docs once papercusp dev is up
   # admin web (port 3001):
   cd apps/web/.next/standalone/apps/web && PORT=3001 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 nohup node server.js > /tmp/web-prod.log 2>&1 &
   # substrate web (port 3055):
   cd /home/marsh-office/Restart && nohup npm run dev:papercusp > /tmp/papercusp-web.log 2>&1 &
   ```

3. **How to verify everything is up**:

   ```bash
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3057 healthz: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3057/healthz
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3055 substrate UI: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3001 admin: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3001/
   curl -s -o /dev/null -w ":3055 docs: %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3055/docs

   curl -s -o /dev/null -w "api.papercuspai.com: %{http_code}\n" https://api.papercuspai.com/healthz
   ```

4. **The Postgres state**:

   ```sql
   -- in `papercusp` DB, schema `papercusp_marketplace`
   SELECT 'packages' AS t, COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.packages
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_versions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_versions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_downloads', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_downloads
   UNION ALL SELECT 'package_retraction_log', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.package_retraction_log
   UNION ALL SELECT 'sessions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.sessions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'webhook_subscriptions', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.webhook_subscriptions
   UNION ALL SELECT 'webhook_deliveries', COUNT(*) FROM papercusp_marketplace.webhook_deliveries;
   ```

   ```plaintext
   GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET=...
   PAPERCUSP_MARKETPLACE_OPERATOR_TOKEN=...
   PAPERCUSP_SESSION_HMAC_KEY=...
   ```

# Multi-harness spawning / communication

> Plan to make harness-spawning + cross-harness coordination first-class substrate features. Auth-bound identity from day one; papercup-org is the first consumer, not a special case.

> **Webapp retired (2026-05-14).** Any `localhost:3055` or `localhost:3070` URL on this page is only reachable while the **Tauri dev shell** is running. Start it with `cd papercusp-desktop && npm run dev`.

Note

**Status (original):** plan, not yet shipped. Goes from architecture decisions through four end-to-end smokes. Estimate: 15–18 days realistic. Companion to [`orchestrator-port`](/internal/docs/implementation/orchestrator-port) — that one ports `run.sh` to TS; this one builds the harness-of-harnesses APIs the ported orchestrator emits actions into.

Shipped, then evolved — read this as the original plan

The multi-harness substrate described here **did ship** and has since moved. Treat the inline file paths below as the plan’s original targets, not current locations:

* `POST /api/admin/execute-action` lives in **`packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/admin/execute-action.ts`** (Hono), alongside `rotate-token.ts` and `prune-executed-actions.ts`. Cross-harness reads are under **`packages/operator-core/lib/endpoint-route/routes/cross-harness/`**.
* The per-harness `config_token` design was later **retired** (migration `121-retire-per-harness-config-token-and-proposals.sql`); token identity was reworked. The orchestrator-emitted spawning is now the `fleet:*` / cross-harness substrate (`packages/operator-core/lib/fleet/operator-spawn.ts`).
* The orchestrator the plan refers to (`run.sh` → TS) was ported and its run-loop later retired; see [orchestrator-port](/internal/docs/implementation/orchestrator-port).

## 1. Goal

[Section titled “1. Goal”](#1-goal)

Make harness-spawning and cross-harness coordination first-class capabilities of the standard harness substrate, with auth-bound identity from day one.

Concretely:

* Any harness whose role config declares `allowedActions: [..., "scaffold_harness"]` can spawn children.
* Any marketplace template that declares `spawnable: { kind, requires }` can be spawned as a child.
* Children whose `parent_slug` is set automatically report completion back to their parent — no per-template hook authoring required.
* Every orchestrator understands it’s running inside Papercusp, can see its parent / children / siblings at a glance, and can pull full state of any other harness on demand via authenticated read APIs.
* Any harness whose role config grants `send_message` can message any other harness, with a declared `reason` recorded in the audit log.
* **Every executeAction call is authenticated against a per-harness shared-secret token; harness identity is derived from the token binding, not from caller-supplied body fields. `parent_slug` and message `from_slug` are derived (not trusted), so spoofing is impossible at the protocol level.**
* The `papercup-org` template is the first template that uses these features, not a special case.

The user-facing demo: drop a directive into the `papercup-org` parent’s inbox, manually invoke its director, watch it spawn children with full context of the org, watch them run while the parent can intervene mid-mission, watch completion flow back.

## 2. Scope

[Section titled “2. Scope”](#2-scope)

Closed-loop manual demo via standard substrate. End-to-end smokes must pass:

* **Smoke A** — papercup-org happy path (directive → spawn → first non-trivial file → completion message in parent inbox)
* **Smoke B** — generic non-`papercup-org` harness can also spawn children (proves the feature is substrate, not template-specific)
* **Smoke C** — neighbor visibility works (a child’s prompt sees its parent’s status; a parent’s prompt sees its children’s statuses; cross-harness supervisor message arrives in child’s prompt-build)
* **Smoke D** — auth model holds: a request without a valid token, with a token bound to harness X claiming to be harness Y, or with a forged `callingHarness` body field, is rejected with 401/403

Autonomy (routine ticker, coordinator dispatch, auditor cadence) is a **separate plan** — not included here.

## 3. Non-goals

[Section titled “3. Non-goals”](#3-non-goals)

* Coordinator dispatch — `NEXT_HARNESS` parses but doesn’t fire children autonomously.
* Auditor cadence — file exists, no scheduler invokes it.
* `add_directive_summary` — context bounded by prompt-build truncation instead.
* `mark_campaign_published`, `pause_project`, `resume_project` — useful, not needed for the loop.
* Briefings plugin — gone, dropped from manifest until source is restored or rebuilt.
* Many-directive scale, multi-week autonomy, KPI dashboards.
* Cross-machine spawn (parent on machine A, child on machine B).
* Spawn quotas / rate limiting per parent.
* Permission tiers beyond `allowedActions[]` and the auth token.
* Per-role addressing (`to: [<harness>:<role>]`); messages address harnesses, not roles within.
* `dryRun: true` for `scaffold_harness` — defer to v1.5.
* Cache-and-verify idempotency replay — v1 is cache-is-authoritative.
* Token rotation for compromised harnesses — manual reissue only in v1.

## 4. Architecture decisions (locked before code)

[Section titled “4. Architecture decisions (locked before code)”](#4-architecture-decisions-locked-before-code)

### Auth & identity

[Section titled “Auth & identity”](#auth--identity)

| Decision                  | Choice                                                                                                                                                                                     | Rationale                                                            |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Per-harness shared secret | `harness_<slug>.config_token` (random 256-bit, base64url) generated at scaffold time, written to `.papercusp/config.json` mode 0600                                                        | Cryptographic identity binding; token serves as both authn and authz |
| Auth header               | `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every executeAction request                                                                                                                             | Standard, simple                                                     |
| Identity derivation       | Executor looks up token in `harness_shared.token_index` to find which harness slug owns it. **`callingHarness` in the request body is REJECTED if it doesn’t match the derived identity.** | Body fields are forgeable; token binding is not                      |
| `parent_slug` sealing     | `parent_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>` on `scaffold_harness`; never read from body                                                                                                        | Real seal, not security theater                                      |
| `from_slug` on messages   | Always = `<derivedCallingHarness>`; body’s `from` field rejected on mismatch                                                                                                               | Stops cross-harness spoofing in the audit log                        |
| Token rotation            | Out of scope for v1; manual deletion of harness + re-scaffold if compromised                                                                                                               | v1 is correctness-floor; rotation is hardening                       |

### Action execution

[Section titled “Action execution”](#action-execution)

| Decision                                   | Choice                                                                                           | Rationale                                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Endpoint shape                             | Slug-less `POST /api/admin/execute-action` with `targetSlug` in action body                      | Many actions cross harnesses; URL-as-context is the wrong frame                                          |
| Verb dispatch                              | Single endpoint with `op` discriminator                                                          | Matches the deleted `org.ts` contract; matches `actions-block.ts`’s POST shape                           |
| State backend                              | PG (per-harness `harness_<slug>.messages`, `harness_shared.projects`)                            | Universal Schema + Zero sync already in place                                                            |
| Caller-supplied idempotency                | `actionId` (UUID) supplied by caller; server returns same `result` on replay                     | Workers retry on flake; double-spinup is unrecoverable                                                   |
| Idempotency replay semantics               | **Cache-is-authoritative.** Cached response returned without verifying side effects still exist. | Documented as v1 boundary; out-of-band mutations break replay correctness; v1.5 can add cache-and-verify |
| Per-action error shape                     | `{ok, actionId, error?, result?}`; ACTIONS array continues past mid-array failures               | Matches `actions-block.ts` loop semantics                                                                |
| Per-verb timeouts                          | `scaffold_harness`: 5 min. All other verbs: 60s.                                                 | Scaffold legitimately needs minutes (`papercusp init`, schema scaffold, etc.); the rest are SQL or fast  |
| `send_message` addressing                  | Any harness → any harness; receiver decides whether to consume via prompt-build                  | Open bus, gated by receiver                                                                              |
| `send_message` reason field                | Required `reason: string` (min 10 chars; warn on placeholder regex but don’t block)              | Friction filters trivial chatter                                                                         |
| `spinup_project` partial-failure semantics | Wrapped in a single PG transaction across all affected per-harness schemas. All-or-nothing.      | Atomicity > diagnostic detail at v1                                                                      |
| `scaffold_harness` slug uniqueness         | `INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`; if conflict → 409 with `error: 'slug already in use'`           | Don’t write to someone else’s schema                                                                     |

### Parent / child structure

[Section titled “Parent / child structure”](#parent--child-structure)

| Decision                       | Choice                                                                                                                                                                                 | Rationale                                                                |
| ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Parent/child relationship      | Optional `parent_slug` column on `harness_shared.projects`, mirrored to `.papercusp/config.json.parent_slug`                                                                           | Structural fact at the registry level; substrate code reads it           |
| Completion-reporting hook      | Default `afterDone.sh` ships in `libs/papercusp/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` and fires when the harness has `parent_slug` set                                                     | One canonical impl, opt-in by config                                     |
| Hook resolution chain          | `<harness-dir>/.papercusp/hooks/<name>.sh` → `<libs>/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/<name>.sh`. **Resolver scans `builtins/` generically; afterDone is the only v1 builtin shipped.** | New builtins (e.g. `onPostValidator.sh`) are then a one-file PR in v1.5+ |
| User-supplied per-harness hook | Wins over builtin                                                                                                                                                                      | Standard hook resolution; backward compatible                            |

### Marketplace contract

[Section titled “Marketplace contract”](#marketplace-contract)

| Decision                                 | Choice                                                                                                                         | Rationale                                                  |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| Template “spawnable” contract            | New manifest field `spawnable: { kind: 'coding'\|'service'\|..., requires: [...] }` in `papercusp.json`                        | Marketplace knows which templates a director can pick from |
| Spawnable-templates discovery            | `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable` returns catalog filtered to `spawnable` entries                                               | Director prompt builds available templates list at runtime |
| `scaffold_harness` template validation   | Executor rejects `template` not in spawnable catalog                                                                           | Prevents directors from spawning marketing-only templates  |
| Adding `spawnable` to existing templates | Bumps patch version (`0.1.0` → `0.1.1`) and re-publishes; documented as the marketplace contract for “additive manifest field” | Avoids undefined-behavior on cached clients                |

### Cross-harness visibility (tiered)

[Section titled “Cross-harness visibility (tiered)”](#cross-harness-visibility-tiered)

| Decision                            | Choice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | Rationale                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Tier 1 — Substrate self-description | Every prompt includes a fixed ”## About Papercusp” preamble (\~300 tokens, identical across all harnesses)                                                                                                                                          | Coherence: orchestrators understand they’re running inside a multi-harness framework                              |
| Tier 2 — Neighbor view              | Every prompt includes a depth-1 view of: parent (if any), children (if any), siblings sharing same `parent_slug`                                                                                                                                    | Bounded growth, sufficient for relational coordination                                                            |
| Tier 2 detail level                 | Parent: slug + recent activity 1-liner + last message between us. Children: slug + feature status counts + last activity ts + **`spawned_count: N`** for grandchild visibility hint. Siblings: slug + status counts. **Plus an aggregate roll-up.** | \~50 tokens each + \~20 tokens roll-up; prevents prompt bloat while flagging where Tier 3 inspection is warranted |
| Tier 3 — Inspect-on-demand          | Read APIs (`/api/harness/projects`, `/api/harness/<slug>/status`, `/api/harness/<slug>/inbox`, `/api/harness/all/recent-activity`) listed in prompt as “available capabilities”; agent invokes when relevant                                        | Full visibility achievable; pay only when needed                                                                  |
| Tier 3 invocation mechanism         | **Verified in Step 0.5** — either `Bash` is wired into `--allowed-tools` (so curl works), or a new MCP tool server `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness({slug})` etc. ships in Step 2.5. **Without this, Tier 3 is dead text.**                          | Don’t promise Tier 3 in prompts the agent can’t act on                                                            |
| Cross-harness inbox consumption     | Each harness’s orchestrator/scoper/worker prompt-build includes its own bounded inbox; consumed messages auto-ack ONLY when orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_*}`; `ESCALATE`/`REVIEW` leave pending                                             | Parent → child mid-mission supervision reaches the agents; user-escalation messages aren’t eaten                  |

### Autonomy (deferred to v2 plan)

[Section titled “Autonomy (deferred to v2 plan)”](#autonomy-deferred-to-v2-plan)

| Decision           | Choice                   | Rationale                                                                                                        |
| ------------------ | ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Autonomy substrate | TBD pending Step 0 spike | Routine plugin if substrate is durable across operator restarts; otherwise PG-backed work queue or systemd timer |

## 5. Steps

[Section titled “5. Steps”](#5-steps)

### Step 0 — Routine substrate spike *(\~30 min)*

[Section titled “Step 0 — Routine substrate spike (\~30 min)”](#step-0--routine-substrate-spike-30-min)

Read `libs/papercusp/packages/plugin-loader/src/routines.ts` (or wherever routines live) and answer:

**Does the routine ticker survive operator process restart?**

* If yes: commit to routine plugin for v2 autoLoop.
* If no: pivot to `pending_events` table + a separate ticker process (systemd timer or sidecar daemon).

**Output:** decision note in `docs/decisions/routine-durability.md`.

**Gate:** none — informational only; this plan doesn’t depend on the answer.

### Step 0.5 — Action-body + auth contract *(\~2 hours)*

[Section titled “Step 0.5 — Action-body + auth contract (\~2 hours)”](#step-05--action-body--auth-contract-2-hours)

Single 2–3 page document at `apps/operator/app/api/_hono/execute-action.contract.md`:

**Auth model:**

* Per-harness token: 256-bit random, base64url, generated at scaffold time, stored at `.papercusp/config.json:harness_token` mode 0600
* Auth header: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` required on every request
* Identity derivation: server queries `harness_shared.token_index` to derive `<derivedCallingHarness>`; if no match → 401
* Body’s `callingHarness`: must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>` or be omitted; mismatch → 403
* Body’s `from` (in `send_message`): must equal `<derivedCallingHarness>`; mismatch → 403
* `parent_slug` (in `scaffold_harness`): NEVER body-controlled; always set by server to `<derivedCallingHarness>`

**Tier 3 verification (the inspect\_harness capability):**

* Confirm whether `claude -p` invocations from `run.sh` include `Bash` in `--allowed-tools`.
* If yes: agent can curl Tier 3 endpoints directly. Step 2.5 is just docs.
* If no: ship `mcp__papercusp__inspectHarness` MCP tools in Step 2.5 wrapping the read endpoints.
* Document the chosen mechanism in this contract.

**Endpoint:**

* `POST /api/admin/execute-action`

* Request body:

  ```ts
  {
    actionId: string,        // UUID supplied by caller, idempotency key
    callingHarness?: string, // optional; must match Bearer-derived if present
    callingDept?: string,    // backwards-compat for run.sh (informational only)
    action: { op: '...', ... }
  }
  ```

* Per-verb request fields:

  * `send_message`: `to[], kind, subject, body, parentMessageId?, reason: string` *(`from` derived)*
  * `mark_message_status`: `messageId, status: 'acknowledged' | 'archived'`
  * `spinup_project`: `directiveId, projectName, projectVertical, projectBudgetCents, departments[]`
  * `scaffold_harness`: `projectSlug, template, spec, goal` *(`parent_slug` derived)*

* Response: `{ok, actionId, result?, error?}`

* Idempotency: same `actionId` → cached response, no re-execution, no side-effect verification (cache-is-authoritative)

* Error categories: `validation_error` (400), `auth_error` (401|403), `not_found` (404), `conflict` (409), `internal` (500)

* Per-verb timeouts: `scaffold_harness` 5 min, others 60s

**Gate:** committed to repo.

### Step 1 — PG schema migration *(\~1d)*

[Section titled “Step 1 — PG schema migration (\~1d)”](#step-1--pg-schema-migration-1d)

Update `bin/scaffold-harness-schema.sh` to add to every per-harness schema:

```sql
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.config_token (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.messages (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  from_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  to_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL,
  subject TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  parent_message_id UUID,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  acknowledged_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'acknowledged', 'archived'))
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (status, created_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (to_slug, status);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.messages (from_slug, created_at);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.supervisor_notes (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  body TEXT NOT NULL,
  source TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_<slug>.executed_actions (
  action_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
  op TEXT NOT NULL,
  caller_slug TEXT NOT NULL,
  target_slug TEXT,
  reason TEXT,
  request JSONB NOT NULL,
  response JSONB NOT NULL,
  executed_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (caller_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (target_slug, executed_at);
CREATE INDEX ON harness_<slug>.executed_actions (op, executed_at);
```

And to `harness_shared`:

```sql
ALTER TABLE harness_shared.projects
  ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS parent_slug TEXT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_projects_parent ON harness_shared.projects (parent_slug);


CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS harness_shared.token_index (
  token TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  harness_slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
```

**Idempotent migration script** `bin/migrate-installed-harnesses-add-messages.sh`:

* For each row in `harness_shared.projects`:

  * If the project path doesn’t exist on disk → log “skip (orphaned registry row)” and continue
  * Else: provision new tables in `harness_<slug>` (idempotent via `IF NOT EXISTS`)
  * Generate a fresh token, write to `<project_path>/.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600), insert into both `harness_<slug>.config_token` and `harness_shared.token_index`

* At end, print summary: `provisioned: N, skipped: M (broken rows), errors: K`

**Verify:** apply against an existing harness; confirm tables; re-run; confirm idempotent. Apply against the 7 currently-broken `papercup-org*` rows; confirm “skipped: 7.”

**Gate:** all installed harnesses (with valid project paths) have the new tables + tokens; broken rows logged but not failed.

### Step 2 — executeAction with 4 verbs + auth *(\~3.5d)*

[Section titled “Step 2 — executeAction with 4 verbs + auth (\~3.5d)”](#step-2--executeaction-with-4-verbs--auth-35d)

New file `apps/operator/app/api/admin/execute-action/route.ts`.

**Auth middleware *(\~0.5d)*:**

* Reject if no `Authorization: Bearer` header (401).
* Look up bearer in `harness_shared.token_index`; if no match → 401.
* Set `derivedCallingHarness = <slug from match>` on request context.
* If body has `callingHarness` and it doesn’t match → 403 with clear error.
* If verb is `send_message` and body has `from` and it doesn’t match → 403.
* If verb is `scaffold_harness` and body has `parent_slug` → 400 (validation error).

**Three SQL-only verbs *(\~1d)*:**

* `send_message`: validate `reason` ≥ 10 chars; placeholder-regex match logs warning to `executed_actions.reason` but proceeds. INSERT into `harness_<to_slug>.messages` with `from_slug = <derivedCallingHarness>`. If `kind === 'Directive'`, also append to `harness_<to_slug>.supervisor_notes`.
* `mark_message_status`: UPDATE `harness_<derivedCallingHarness>.messages` (only your own inbox/outbox is yours to mark) `SET status = $2, acknowledged_at = now() WHERE id = $1`.
* `spinup_project`: opens a PG transaction across all affected schemas; INSERT into `harness_shared.projects`; for each requested department, recurse-in-process to fire follow-up `send_message` (kickoff/priority/budget) within the same transaction. Single COMMIT or single ROLLBACK. Returns `{subActions: [{actionId, op, ok}, ...]}` for diagnostic detail.

**`scaffold_harness` *(\~1.75d)*:**

* Validate `projectSlug`, `template`, `spec`, `goal`.
* Look up `template` in the spawnable catalog. If not present or `spawnable` field absent, reject with `validation_error: 'template not spawnable'`.
* Check slug uniqueness: query `harness_shared.projects WHERE slug = $1`. If exists → 409 `slug already in use`.
* Shell out to `papercusp init <projectSlug> --from <template>` with **5-minute** timeout.
* After init succeeds, atomically merge `parent_slug: <derivedCallingHarness>` into the new harness’s `.papercusp/config.json`.
* Generate `harness_token`, write to the new harness’s `.papercusp/config.json` (chmod 0600).
* Call internal harness-projects registration with `parent_slug` (which provisions the per-harness PG schema, including the new `config_token` + `token_index` rows).
* On partial scaffold (init succeeded, register failed): error response includes the partially-created path so retry with same `actionId` cleans up + retries. Idempotency check on `executed_actions` short-circuits before any FS work.
* On `papercusp init` failure: rollback any partial directory creation, return `internal` error with stderr.
* On 5-min timeout: SIGTERM → SIGKILL → rollback, return `internal` error with `timeout: true`.

**Idempotency wrapper *(\~0.25d)*:**

```ts
const cached = await getExecutedAction(actionId, callerSlug);
if (cached) return cached.response;  // cache-is-authoritative; documented
const result = await dispatch(action);
await saveExecutedAction({
  actionId, op: action.op, callerSlug: derivedCallingHarness,
  targetSlug: extractTargetSlug(action), reason: action.reason ?? null,
  request: action, response: result,
});
return result;
```

Verify each verb individually with curl (using a real bearer token), including auth-failure paths; commit each verb as its own commit.

**Gate:** all four verbs return 200 on happy path + 4xx on validation failures + 401/403 on auth failures + 409 on slug conflicts + idempotent on `actionId` replay.

### Step 4.5 — Builtin completion hook *(\~0.5d)*

[Section titled “Step 4.5 — Builtin completion hook (\~0.5d)”](#step-45--builtin-completion-hook-05d)

New file `libs/papercusp/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/afterDone.sh`:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Built-in: notify parent harness on mission completion.
# Fires only when this harness has parent_slug set in .papercusp/config.json.
# User-supplied .papercusp/hooks/afterDone.sh overrides this entirely.
set -e
PARENT_SLUG="$(jq -r '.parent_slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$PARENT_SLUG" ] && exit 0  # no parent, silent success


TOKEN="$(jq -r '.harness_token // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$TOKEN" ] && { echo "afterDone: no harness_token in config; skipping" >&2; exit 0; }


SELF_SLUG="$(jq -r '.slug // empty' .papercusp/config.json 2>/dev/null)"
[ -z "$SELF_SLUG" ] && SELF_SLUG="$(basename "$PWD")"


ACTION_ID="$(uuidgen)"
BASE="${PAPERCUSP_OPERATOR_BASE:-http://localhost:3055}"


curl -sS --max-time 30 -X POST "$BASE/api/admin/execute-action" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d "$(jq -nc \
    --arg id "$ACTION_ID" \
    --arg to "$PARENT_SLUG" \
    '{actionId: $id, action: {op: "send_message", to: [$to], kind: "Completion", subject: "mission DONE", body: "", reason: "afterDone substrate hook: notifying parent of mission completion"}}')" \
  > /dev/null
```

Update `run.sh`’s `run_hook` to scan `${HARNESS_LIB_DIR}/packages/harness/hooks/builtins/` for any matching `<name>.sh` and fall through when no per-harness override exists. Generic resolver, ship one builtin (`afterDone`) for v1.

**Gate:** seed `parent_slug` + `harness_token` in a test harness’s config.json, run a short mission to DONE, verify the parent’s `harness_<parent>.messages` table has the Completion row with `from_slug = <child-slug>`.

### Step 4.6 — Bounded inbox in coding-harness prompt-build *(\~0.5d)*

[Section titled “Step 4.6 — Bounded inbox in coding-harness prompt-build (\~0.5d)”](#step-46--bounded-inbox-in-coding-harness-prompt-build-05d)

Update prompt-build for orchestrator, scoper, and worker so each iteration’s prompt includes:

```markdown
## Recent supervisor messages (from parent: <parent_slug>)
- 2026-05-01T14:32 [BudgetIncrease] from papercup-org-business: "raised your budget to $500"
- 2026-05-01T14:18 [Priority] from papercup-org: "focus on auth before dashboard"
```

Drawn from `harness_<self>.messages WHERE to_slug = <self> AND status = 'pending' AND from_slug = <parent_slug> ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5`.

**Auto-acknowledge scoping:** at end of iteration, if orchestrator decision ∈ `{DONE, NEXT_WORKER, NEXT_VALIDATOR, NEXT_ARCHITECT, NEXT_HARNESS, ...}` (the “happy progression” verbs), mark consumed messages as `acknowledged`. If decision ∈ `{ESCALATE, REVIEW, FEATURE_FREEZE}` or iteration fails non-zero, leave messages pending so the next iteration (after user intervention) sees them again.

**Gate:** drop a `send_message` from a parent harness to a running child; the child’s next iteration’s prompt includes it; after the iteration completes with `NEXT_WORKER`, the message status flips to `acknowledged`. Repeat with an iteration that `ESCALATE`s; verify message remains pending.

### Step 6 — Four integration smokes *(\~2d)*

[Section titled “Step 6 — Four integration smokes (\~2d)”](#step-6--four-integration-smokes-2d)

#### Smoke A — papercup-org happy path

[Section titled “Smoke A — papercup-org happy path”](#smoke-a--papercup-org-happy-path)

```plaintext
1. Reset state: prune any existing papercup-org* rows + delete project dirs.
2. Reinstall: papercusp install papercup-org.
3. Drop directive into parent inbox via curl POST /api/harness/papercup-org/messages,
   kind=Directive, body="write a single static index.html that says 'hello world'".
4. Manually invoke parent director:
   curl POST /api/harness/papercup-org/invoke?role=director.
5. Wait up to 5 min for the director run to complete.
6. Assert: parent's executed_actions table has at least one spinup_project and one
   scaffold_harness, each with a non-empty `reason`, with caller_slug = papercup-org.
7. Assert: a new child harness slug appears in GET /api/harness/projects with hasState=true,
   hasSpec=true, parent_slug=papercup-org.
8. Assert: the child's harness_<slug> PG schema exists with messages + executed_actions tables
   + a config_token row.
9. Manually invoke the child loop with a generous timeout: papercusp run <child-slug>
   --max-iterations 10.
10. Wait until the child writes its first non-trivial file (an index.html with content)
    OR reaches DONE — whichever comes first, max 5 min.
11. Assert: builtin afterDone hook fired (only if DONE was reached) — executed_actions
    has a send_message op with from_slug=<child-slug>, kind='Completion', reason populated.
12. Assert: parent's GET /inbox shows the Completion message at status='pending'
    (or, if step 10 stopped at "first file written," assert that the child has a real
    file on disk — proves the spawn produced a working harness even if it didn't
    fully complete).
```

#### Smoke B — generic harness spawning (proves the feature is generic)

[Section titled “Smoke B — generic harness spawning (proves the feature is generic)”](#smoke-b--generic-harness-spawning-proves-the-feature-is-generic)

```plaintext
1. Create a fresh harness "test-spawner-org" via:
   papercusp init test-spawner-org --target /tmp/test-spawner-org.
2. Hand-edit .papercusp/config.json to set:
     harness_kind: 'org'
     roles.director.allowedActions = ["scaffold_harness", "send_message"]
3. Drop a directive into its inbox via curl.
4. Manually invoke its director.
5. Assert: director emits scaffold_harness for some spawnable template (e.g. papercup-coding).
6. Assert: child appears in registry with parent_slug=test-spawner-org.
7. Run child to DONE.
8. Assert: builtin afterDone fires; Completion message lands in test-spawner-org's inbox.
```

If Smoke B passes without any code referencing “papercup-org” by name, the substrate is generic.

#### Smoke C — tiered visibility & cross-harness coordination

[Section titled “Smoke C — tiered visibility & cross-harness coordination”](#smoke-c--tiered-visibility--cross-harness-coordination)

```plaintext
1. From the papercup-org install (Smoke A's state):
2. Build the prompt for parent director (without invoking claude — emit only):
   curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org/prompt?role=director.
3. Assert: prompt contains "## About Papercusp" preamble.
4. Assert: prompt contains "## Neighbor harnesses" with 6 children listed including
   spawned_count fields and an aggregate roll-up.
5. Assert: prompt contains "## Available read capabilities" listing inspect endpoints.
6. Assert: prompt total framing tokens (excluding own SPEC + state) <= 2000.
7. From a department harness, build its prompt:
   curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org-business/prompt?role=director.
8. Assert: prompt contains parent (papercup-org) in neighbor view + 5 siblings.
9. Send a parent → child supervisor message:
   curl POST /api/admin/execute-action (with papercup-org's token), op=send_message,
   to=[papercup-org-business], kind=Priority, body="focus on auth",
   reason="testing supervisor channel".
10. Build the child's worker prompt:
    curl GET /api/harness/papercup-org-business/prompt?role=worker.
11. Assert: prompt's "## Recent supervisor messages" section contains the Priority message.
12. Run worker once with NEXT_WORKER outcome.
13. Assert: the message's status is now 'acknowledged'.
14. Send another supervisor message; run worker once with ESCALATE outcome.
15. Assert: the message remains 'pending' (auto-ack scope honored).
```

#### Smoke D — auth model holds

[Section titled “Smoke D — auth model holds”](#smoke-d--auth-model-holds)

```plaintext
1. Send executeAction with no Authorization header.
   Assert: 401.
2. Send with bogus bearer token.
   Assert: 401.
3. Send with valid token for harness X, body claiming callingHarness: 'Y'.
   Assert: 403 with clear error about identity mismatch.
4. Send valid send_message with body.from = 'Y' (X's token).
   Assert: 403.
5. Send valid scaffold_harness with body.parent_slug = 'attacker-controlled'.
   Assert: 400 (validation_error: parent_slug not caller-controlled) OR
           the field is silently dropped and parent_slug is set to X (verify which).
6. Send valid scaffold_harness with projectSlug = 'papercup-org' (already exists).
   Assert: 409, slug already in use.
7. Send executeAction with reason='asdf'.
   Assert: 200 (proceeds) but executed_actions row carries a quality flag.
8. Send executeAction with reason='' or missing.
   Assert: 400, validation_error.
```

**Gate for ship:** all four smokes pass twice from clean state.

## 7. Risks

[Section titled “7. Risks”](#7-risks)

| Risk                                                                                             | Severity                        | Mitigation                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Routine substrate is in-process; no v2 autonomy path is viable                                   | High for v2, none for this plan | Step 0 surfaces this early                                                                                      |
| Existing templates don’t have `spawnable` field; `scaffold_harness` can’t find anything to spawn | High                            | Step 5b explicitly re-publishes; Smoke A validates                                                              |
| `inspect_harness` capability isn’t actually wired; Tier 3 is dead text                           | High                            | Step 0.5 verifies; Step 2.5 wires if needed; gate before Step 3                                                 |
| `claude -p` doesn’t preserve auth tokens cleanly across invocations (env leak risk)              | Med                             | Tokens from `.papercusp/config.json`, mode 0600, never logged; verify in Smoke D                                |
| Tier 2 neighbor view explodes for orgs with 15+ children                                         | Med                             | Smoke C asserts <2000 tokens for 6 children; if violated, paginate                                              |
| `scaffold_harness` shell-out flakes (init fails halfway)                                         | Med                             | Idempotency on `actionId` + rollback of partial scaffold + 5-min timeout with SIGTERM/SIGKILL                   |
| Paperclip stomps the new files                                                                   | Med                             | 2-day buffer; commit fast; monitor `pgrep -af paperclip`                                                        |
| Auto-acknowledge in Step 4.6 marks ESCALATE-iteration messages consumed                          | Med                             | Scope: ack only on DONE/NEXT\_\*; explicitly tested in Smoke C step 14-15                                       |
| Out-of-band registry mutation breaks idempotency replay (cache-is-authoritative)                 | Med                             | Documented as v1 boundary; not a v1 bug                                                                         |
| Cross-harness messaging gets noisy without throttling                                            | Med                             | `reason` field min-10-char + placeholder regex flag; v2 adds throttling if usage data shows >50/day per harness |
| `spinup_project` cross-schema transaction has unexpected isolation issues                        | Med                             | Use serializable isolation; if cross-schema TX is problematic, fall back to sub-action retry pattern            |
| Token compromise has no rotation path in v1                                                      | Med                             | Documented in `auth-and-identity.mdx`; mitigation = uninstall+reinstall harness                                 |
| Hook resolver scans `builtins/` but new builtins might collide with user hooks                   | Low                             | User hook always wins; lookup order documented                                                                  |
| Recursive spawning blows up                                                                      | Low                             | Smokes don’t exercise; v2 concern                                                                               |
| `executed_actions` grows unbounded                                                               | Low                             | 30-day prune in v1.5                                                                                            |
| `harness_shared.token_index` lookup contention under load                                        | Low                             | Indexed PK; v1 traffic is hand-driven                                                                           |

## 8. Acceptance criteria

[Section titled “8. Acceptance criteria”](#8-acceptance-criteria)

* All 4 verbs implemented and individually green via authenticated curl
* All 4 verbs idempotent on `actionId` replay (cache-is-authoritative documented)
* All requests rejected with 401 if no/invalid bearer token
* All requests rejected with 403 if body claims a harness identity not bound to the bearer token
* `parent_slug` and `from_slug` always derived from the bearer token, never from body
* `papercusp install papercup-org@0.1.1` materializes 7 working harness dirs each with a `harness_token`
* Builtin `afterDone` hook fires for any harness with `parent_slug` set, including non-papercup-org harnesses
* At least one non-papercup-org template has `spawnable: true` and is reachable via `GET /api/marketplace/spawnable`
* `papercup-org` template re-bundled with NO per-dept afterDone scripts
* Every prompt includes the “About Papercusp” preamble + neighbor view (with `spawned_count` + aggregate) + Tier 3 capabilities
* Tier 3 capability is verified to actually work end-to-end (agent can inspect)
* Coding-harness prompt-build includes own bounded inbox; auto-ack only on DONE/NEXT\_\* decisions
* `send_message` requires `reason` ≥10 chars; placeholder regex matches log a quality flag
* `scaffold_harness` enforces slug uniqueness with 409
* `scaffold_harness` 5-minute timeout enforced
* `spinup_project` recursion is transactional (all-or-nothing across schemas)
* Migration script handles broken registry rows: skip + log
* Smoke A passes twice from clean state
* Smoke B passes twice from clean state — no code in either path references “papercup-org” by name
* Smoke C passes twice — neighbor view + cross-harness messaging + auto-ack scoping verified
* Smoke D passes twice — auth model holds against forgery attempts
* No regressions in `sheets` standalone coding-harness flow
* Estimates updated to actuals; deltas analyzed

# Run.sh → TS orchestrator port (handoff)

> TypeScript port of the bash autonomous-harness orchestrator. State as of 2026-04-27.

The ported run-loop is now RETIRED (2026-06-06)

This is a **historical handoff doc**. The TS run-loop this port produced (`main-loop.ts`, `bin/run.ts`, `pre-loop.ts`, the checkpoints/snapshots/dispatches cluster) was retired and archived to `libs/papercusp/_retired/orchestrator-run-loop/` (plan `archive-legacy-orchestrator-deadcode-2026-06-06`; git tag `legacy-orchestrator-run-loop-retired-2026-06-06`) — superseded by the **DBOS durable pipeline** (`packages/operator-core/lib/dbos/`). Parts of the port live on inside that pipeline: `invoke.ts`, `lanes.ts`, the worker chunk-loop, `cost-cap.ts`, `decision-parse.ts`. The `papercusp-orchestrate` bin and the `PAPERCUSP_USE_TS_ORCHESTRATOR` fall-through described below no longer exist.

## Why this exists

[Section titled “Why this exists”](#why-this-exists)

The autonomous-harness orchestrator was historically a 2,122-line bash script (`libs/papercusp/packages/harness/run.sh`). The desktop app needs to drop the bash prereq for Windows users (Git for Windows is currently required to run the loop). A TypeScript port of `run.sh` achieves that without losing Claude Max subscription support — the port keeps the agent CLI (`omp -p` by default, `claude -p` opt-in) as a child-process spawn rather than switching to the SDK.

Hard constraint for handoff

Do **not** swap the agent CLI (`omp -p` or `claude -p`) for `@anthropic-ai/sdk`. Both CLIs handle Claude Max auth via the user’s Claude Code session (omp via Meridian’s SDK-bridge, claude directly); the SDK route requires API keys and breaks Max users. The whole point of the port is to drop bash, not the CLI layer.

## Where it lives

[Section titled “Where it lives”](#where-it-lives)

New package `@papercusp/orchestrator` at `libs/papercusp/packages/orchestrator/` (in the `papercupai/papercusp` submodule). Feature-flagged via `PAPERCUSP_USE_TS_ORCHESTRATOR=1` — currently opt-in. The CLI entry `bin/run.ts` handles the flag and falls through to bash for any decision branch the TS port doesn’t yet cover.
